name: Field extraction from an invoice into JSON

messages.content: Extract the fields from the invoice text. Reply with ONLY a JSON object with the keys invoice_number, vendor, total_due and due_date (ISO 8601 date). Copy the invoice number exactly as written. No markdown.

INVOICE
Invoice No: INV-2291-B
From: Contoso Facilities Services
Bill to: Litware Inc.
Line 1: Window cleaning, 4 visits ......... 890.00
Line 2: Gutter clearing ................. 394.50
Subtotal ................................ 1,284.50
Tax (0%) ................................ 0.00
TOTAL DUE: 1,284.50 USD
Payment due within 30 days of 15 August 2026.
